text: Assumption: Driver Object 0 acts as the central internal reference random number generator for all further driver objects of the same partition — is this correct?

norm: driver object 0 acts as the central internal reference random number generator for all further driver objects of the same partition
assumption: Driver Object 0 acts as the central internal reference random number generator for all further driver objects of the same partition.
rationale: SWS_Crypto_00224 and SWS_Crypto_00225 obligate driver objects without their own RNG to Object 0, but do not designate any cross-partition synchronization.
